videos.title: The 4 Cosmic Ages of Humanity ⏳ (Are We in the End Times?)
videos.description:
We are living in the final, darkest age of cosmic history. Discover the mind-bending prophecy of the 4 Yugas—from the golden age of gods to the chaotic end times we live in today. Will you survive the final reset? 

Scene Breakdown:
1. The Hook: The warning of the final age.
2. Satya Yuga: The Golden Age of Truth.
3. Treta & Dwapara: The Age of Heroes and Avatars.
4. Kali Yuga: Our current Dark Age.
5. The Prophecy: The arrival of Kalki.

#yugas #hindumyths #cosmology #kalki #ancienthistory #shorts

scenes.narration: We are living in the final, darkest age of humanity... and our time is rapidly running out.
scenes.visual_prompt: A colossal, glowing cosmic wheel of time, the Kaalchakra, slowly turning in the deep dark void of space. Volumetric god rays slice through swirling violet nebulae. A hyper-realistic, dramatic close-up of a giant stone-carved face of Lord Shiva, his third eye glowing with a subtle, menacing gold light. 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

scenes.narration: It began with Satya Yuga—the Golden Age of absolute truth, where gods walked openly among pure humans.
scenes.visual_prompt: An ethereal, breathtaking landscape of Satya Yuga. Majestic white marble temples floating on clouds, surrounded by lush golden forests and crystal-clear waterfalls. Divine beings with radiant halos and glowing white robes walking peacefully. Warm, heavenly sunbeams casting a divine glow. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, cinematic masterpiece.

scenes.narration: Then came the ages of legends... Treta and Dwapara. Great battles of dharma, fought by avatars with weapons of cosmic power!
scenes.visual_prompt: A dramatic split-screen cinematic shot. On the left, Lord Rama holding a massive golden bow glowing with divine solar energy. On the right, Lord Krishna on a golden chariot in the dusty Kurukshetra battlefield, his Sudarshana Chakra spinning rapidly on his finger, emitting blinding blue light. Dark stormy sky, swirling embers, epic mythological cinema style.

scenes.narration: Now, we drown in Kali Yuga—the Age of Darkness. An era of chaos, greed, and the decay of the human soul.
scenes.visual_prompt: A hyper-realistic, dystopian modern city crumbling under a violent violet lightning storm. A lone, shadowy figure standing on a skyscraper edge, looking down at neon-lit chaotic streets filled with smog. Dark, moody, atmospheric, high-contrast cinematic lighting.

scenes.narration: But when the darkness reaches its peak... Kalki, the final avatar, will descend to destroy evil and restart the cycle. Are you ready?
scenes.visual_prompt: A majestic, blazing white stallion galloping down from the swirling cosmic clouds. Atop the horse is the Kalki avatar, clad in glowing golden Vedic armor, unsheathing a fiery sword that cuts through the dark nebulae. Epic, high-budget movie trailer climax, blinding divine light, 8k resolution.
